localizedNotes.en: Build pipeline converged onto aibox-tsbuild: the bundle is now structure-preserving multi-file ESM that maps 1:1 to the sources instead of a single app.js. Runtime shape is unchanged (still a prebuilt bundle, zero on-device transpilation); no functional or UI changes.

manifest.name: 视频下载
manifest.summary: 解析视频页、选画质、离线资料库

localizedSummaries.en: Parse a video page, pick a quality, keep an offline library

actions.name: inspect
actions.summary: Reads a video page or stream URL and reports what can be downloaded: title, uploader, duration, and every available quality with its format id, container, codecs and size. Nothing is downloaded. Pass the chosen format id to the fetch action. Supports Bilibili, YouTube, direct media links, m3u8 streams and generic pages with an embedded video.

actions.name: fetch
actions.summary: Downloads a video the user is entitled to save, for offline viewing. Give the page or stream "url"; add "formatId" (from the inspect action) to choose a quality, otherwise the best one is used. Set "audioOnly" to keep only the audio track as .m4a. Returns a jobId immediately — videos are large, so track it with the library action. HLS sources produce an in-app offline package rather than a portable mp4.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","required":["url"],"properties":{"url":{"type":"string"},"formatId":{"type":"string","description":"Format id from the inspect action. Omit for best quality."},"audioOnly":{"type":"boolean","description":"Keep only the audio track as .m4a. Default false."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: library
actions.summary: Lists downloaded videos and in-flight video downloads with their state and progress, or acts on one of them. "action": "list" (default) / "status" / "pause" / "resume" / "cancel" / "retry" / "play" / "export" — everything except list and status needs a "jobId". "export" turns an HLS offline package into a portable mp4; direct downloads are already mp4.
